entities.summary: Veniamin Aleksandrovich Kaverin was a Soviet and Russian writer, dramatist and screenwriter associated with the early 1920s movement of the Serapion Brothers. Veniamin Kaverin was a authors & novelists from Pskov (1902-04-19, Pskov–1989-05-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
